rationale: Braking behavior is itself what must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. H-3 establishes the operational context and hazardous braking without an obstacle; SG-3 establishes the prevention goal. FR-7 supports normal obstacle-avoidance braking as the intended counterpart against which unintended braking is distinguished. P does not incorporate the sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation, or timing mechanisms that may influence braking.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” directly identifies the system behavior addressed by the evaluation target.
The straight-ahead urban-road situation at 50 km/h, in good weather with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, reproduces H-3's operational context.
“Unintended braking without an obstacle in front” captures the hazardous behavior described in H-3.
“Normal braking to avoid obstacles” is supported by FR-7 as the intended-braking counterpart, rather than an additional implementation mechanism.
